newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says to auction 2-yr notes on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says to auction 2-yr notes on Thursday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to offer two-year government notes through a price-competitive auction on Thursday, a MOF official said on Wednesday.
Traders said the MOF is likely to offer 120 billion yen worth of the notes, the same volume as in the previous auction held on December 25.
The coupon rate is likely to be set at 0.6 percent, also unchanged from the previous offer, they said.
